Stats

Tressym
Tara is a  Tressym, a cat-like Monstrosity, and  Gale's fluffy companion and assistant.
“
We have a great deal of catching up to do. Eat that, wash your hands, and for the love of all that's dear, a shave. Then you can fill me in on what I've missed.
„
— Tara, speaking to Gale

Overview

Background

Gale conjured Tara when he was ten years old, after his parents refused to give him a kitten. Tara and Gale's mom eventually became friends, with Tara visiting her after Gale left home. Tara affectionately refers to Gale as "the most expensive pet in Waterdeep", and later states that they both belong to each other.

Involvement

Act One

Tara first appears upon the first Long Rest of the game if Gale is chosen as origin. She notes Gale's somewhat ill appearance, and expresses concern. She also provides Gale with a magic item, the  Ring of Evasion, that he can consume when he awakes, to prevent the Netherese Orb from detonating. She remains within the Campsite.

Act Three

Tara appears - regardless of the player character - on the roof of the Open Hand Temple in Rivington. She is involved in the quest ⁠Find the Missing Letters, and has unique dialogue when Gale is in the party. It is also possible to get the  Ring of Blink here, whether having Gale in the party or not.

After this encounter Tara can be found on the roof of the Devil's Fee in the Lower City, where she used to sell the  Hat of the Sharp Caster. In order to progress Tara to her third location now, the party must acquire the Hat of the Sharp Caster from atop the entrance awning of Sorcerous Sundries (via Telekinesis or an Arrow of Roaring Thunder), reverse pickpocket it onto her, buy it back from her, and then take a long rest.

The third encounter takes place on the roof of Highberry's Home, where Tara sells the  Slinging Shoes.

Epilogue

Tara appears during the Epilogue, accompanying Gale to the celebration in most endings.

If Gale reforged the  Crown of Karsus and gave it to Mystra, then talking to Tara causes her to invite the player character to her and Gale's tower, remembering the player character as "the one who saved Faerûn alongside Mr Dekarios".

If Gale reforged the Crown of Karsus and ascended to godhood, she expresses disappointment in her friend's transformation and failure to learn from his past mistakes.

If Gale sacrificed himself to destroy the  Netherbrain with his Netherese Orb, Tara mentions how much she misses him and invites the player character to visit Gale's mother in the future.

If the player character transformed into an illithid to fight the Netherbrain, then Tara remarks they must have sacrificed quite a bit to save Faerûn.

Items sold

If spoken to with Gale in the party during the quest ⁠Find the Missing Letters, Tara appears on various rooftops in Lower City, selling one magical item each time. After buying an item and taking a Long Rest, Tara can be found on another rooftop, selling a new item.

Tara accepts most magical items and any type of  Fish in exchange for her items. The fish are exchanged for their gold value and must be outside of a Camp Supply Sack in order to be seen in the bartering menu. Tara can also be pickpocketed for the item at each location. However it should be noted that pickpocketing the item stops her from appearing at the next location; the item must be purchased on the roof of the Devil's Fee for Tara to appear again on Highberry Home's roof.

  • Hat of the Sharp Caster – on the roof of the Devil's Fee at X: -29 Y: 6
  • Slinging Shoes – on the roof of Highberry's Home at X: 1 Y: -36

Loot

  • Tressym Collar

Related Quests

  • ⁠Find the Missing Letters
  • ⁠The Wizard of Waterdeep

Notes

  • Tressyms usually are unable to speak. Tara, however, is capable of speech, likely through external magical means.
  • Tara refuses to stop using Gale's surname, referring to him as "Mr. Dekarios".
  • Tara nags Gale about being single.
  • Gale asked Halaster - presumably  Halaster Blackcloak - to take care of Tara in his absence.
  • If a party member offers fish or a magical item in the barter screen, then clicks on the "balance offer" button, money is used to make up the difference. The party can then remove the original item offered and press the balance offer button again to top up the offer with gold.
